42501.name: INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGE
42501.cause: Row Level Security (RLS) policy blocks the query, or database permissions are missing.

23505.name: UNIQUE_VIOLATION
23505.cause: Attempted to insert a duplicate value into a column with a UNIQUE constraint (e.g. duplicate email).

22P02.name: INVALID_TEXT_REPRESENTATION
22P02.cause: Malformed input syntax (e.g. sending a normal string instead of a valid UUID string).

23502.name: NOT_NULL_VIOLATION
23502.cause: Attempted to insert a null value into a column that is marked as NOT NULL (missing required field).

23503.name: FOREIGN_KEY_VIOLATION
23503.cause: A reference to another table does not exist (e.g. inserting a note for a user_id that doesn't exist in auth.users).

PGRST116.name: SINGLE_ROW_NOT_FOUND
PGRST116.cause: Using .single() on a query that returned 0 rows (item not found).

validation_failed.name: VALIDATION_FAILED
validation_failed.cause: The signup password is too short, or the email address has an invalid format.

invalid_credentials.name: INVALID_CREDENTIALS
invalid_credentials.cause: The email or password typed during login is incorrect.

user_already_exists.name: USER_ALREADY_EXISTS
user_already_exists.cause: The email address is already registered in the system.

email_not_confirmed.name: EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED
email_not_confirmed.cause: Email confirmation is turned on in your dashboard, and the user hasn't clicked the link yet.

invalid_grant.name: INVALID_GRANT
invalid_grant.cause: The login session, refresh token, or magic link token has expired or is invalid.
